column2: wilcoxon_test <- function(x1, x2, B = 10000, alpha = 0.05, method = "independent") {
if (!is.numeric(x1) || !is.numeric(x2)) stop("Both x1 and x2 must be numeric vectors.")
if (B <= 0 || !is.numeric(B)) stop("Number of bootstrap samples (B) must be a positive integer.")
n1 <- length(x1)
observed_stat <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(x1, x2)$statistic,
error = function(e) stop("Error in calculating observed Wilcoxon statistic:", e))
bootstrap_stats <- numeric(B)
if (method == "independent") {
for (i in 1:B) {
sample_x1 <- sample(x1, size = n1, replace = TRUE)
sample_x2 <- sample(x2, size = length(x2), replace = TRUE)
bootstrap_stats[i] <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(sample_x1, sample_x2)$statistic,
error = function(e) NA)
} else if (method == "pooled") {
combined <- c(x1, x2)
centered <- combined - mean(combined)
for (i in 1:B) {
resample_x1 <- sample(centered, size = n1, replace = TRUE)
resample_x2 <- sample(centered, size = length(x2), replace = TRUE)
bootstrap_stats[i] <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(resample_x1, resample_x2)$statistic,
error = function(e) NA)
} else {
stop("Invalid method. Use 'independent' or 'pooled'.")
p_value <- mean(bootstrap_stats >= observed_stat, na.rm = TRUE)
ci <- quantile(bootstrap_stats, probs = c(alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2), na.rm = TRUE)
list(p_value = p_value, ci = ci, observed_stat = observed_stat)
wilcoxon_independent <- wilcoxon_test(x1, x2, method = "independent")
